notes.title: Update Notes 01/14/25
notes.content:
Another small patch:

- Cassowaries fix so they don't leave the area (preventing a bug that occurs if that happens)
- Small credits tweak
- Skip puzzle fix in last area

Thanks for playing! :) 

- Nico

notes.title: Update Notes 12.12.24
notes.content:
Hello again! 

This is version 1.14 which includes some minor fixes that addresses very particular corner cases.


 Menu disabled when new game is being loaded, to prevent errors.
 Grid reset on Merriton to prevent objects mess up the animation.
 Other minor tweaks!


Thanks for playing! Hope you enjoy your time with Arranger!
Share with friends! And remember to review the game please! Helps A LOT.

- Nico

notes.title: UPDATE NOTES 09/30/24
notes.content: - Small fix to the cassowary puzzle to prevent softblocks

notes.title: Update Notes 09/25
notes.content:
Version 1.1.12

QoL updates
- Revamped save system to prevent unplayable states if the game experiences any crash or problem during specific moments
- Minor bug fixes and tweaks

notes.title: Update notes 09/02
notes.content:
Version 1.1.11

- Another cassowary fix :)
- Tiles weren't being loaded properly, that's fixed now! Just a silly cosmetic thing.

notes.title: Update Notes 08/30
notes.content:
Version 1.1.10

- Softlock addressed in laser puzzles in Merriton

And that's it, pretty small patch :)

notes.title: Update Notes 08/26
notes.content: - Last dream tiles disappearing bug has been fixed, along with some logic to unblock players if they got stuck there already. On loading the game, the issue should be automatically resolved.

notes.title: Update Notes 08/22
notes.content:
- First pull-rope puzzle (one of the caves in 3rd wilderness area) fixed
- Falling tiles reload-state fixed (visual error)
- Reloading game inside temple, fixed
- Rope bridge fixed (visual error and initialization error)
- Fireflies not unlocking secret path fixed
- Cloud save tweaked so the config files remain exclusive for each device

notes.title: Update Notes 08.20
notes.content:
New version 1.1.7

- If blocked in cassowary puzzle, game will reset automatically
- Fixed: when trapped squirrel gets reset the spider web is also reset
- If blocked in static lamps puzzle, game will reset automatically
- Fixed visual error related with the hidden fireflies path after reloading saved game
- Fixed DJ typo
- Credits updated

notes.title: Update Notes 08/03
notes.content:
- Version 1.1.6

-- Unblock (reset room) in rare situations in one of the puzzles in rookery
-- Squirrel in first wilderness area now is respawned everytime you (a) load the game (b) enter the area

notes.title: Update Notes 08/02
notes.content: - Minor fix to prevent confusing results on omelette optional puzzle in the last area

notes.title: Update Notes 08/01
notes.content:
Version 1.1.4

- Updated on MacOS
- Also unblock provided for rare softlock in static-lamp puzzle in last town

notes.title: Update Notes 07/31
notes.content:
Version 1.1.3

- Now respawning objects related to achievement in first town in the rare case they get blocked in Nimbus' house
- Japanese logo updating on start if that's the device default language

notes.title: Update Notes 07/30
notes.content:
- Reloading saved data in some areas fixed (mainly provoking issues in Merriton)
- Characters in Hurveth were missing after save n loading after act 3

notes.title: Update Notes 07/29
notes.content:
Rookery remote controlled bird error that could lead to a softlock, now fixed
 Vibration ON/OFF toggle added to the controls settings and only available if you are playing with a controller
 Save error fixed in the first "tune in" sequence with Mog
 Following servants behavior updated 
 Block after vista (autosave) fixed

notes.title: Minor Update #2 07/26
notes.content:
- ES dialogues updated
- Block in first wilderness area fixed (if you completed the optional puzzles of that area and saved the game in the first area outside of the first town)

notes.title: Update notes 07/26
notes.content:
- Anthill area fixed to prevent rare blocks
- Correction to wrong saved elements in the ants line (just visually)
- Sub-tasks logic updated to prevent completed tasks to be added again in log
- Mog lost situation in later areas addressed
